import urllib.request
from Bio import SeqIO
import io

def get_fasta_isoforms(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}.fasta?includeIsoform=true"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        fasta_data = response.read().decode()
    
    from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis
    for record in SeqIO.parse(io.StringIO(fasta_data), "fasta"):
        seq = str(record.seq).replace('X', '').replace('U', '')
        pa = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
        print(record.id, len(record.seq), f"{pa.molecular_weight() / 1000.0:.2f} kDa", f"{pa.molecular_weight():.1f} Da")

print("NETO1:")
get_fasta_isoforms("Q8TDF5")
print("\nPOLL:")
get_fasta_isoforms("Q9UGP5")
